issues.description: Same-state reingests are treated as unchanged when only resources, user, partition, submit/start, GPU count, or exit code change, leaving stale accounting data in SQLite.
Timestamp filtering and newest-record logic compare ISO strings lexically, which gives wrong results for timezone-aware timestamps instead of comparing absolute datetimes.
Timezone-aware timestamps are accepted and preserved without normalization, feeding values into report queries that cannot compare offsets correctly.
Rows with empty user/partition/exit code or negative CPU/GPU counts are accepted, allowing nonsensical usage totals and weak data integrity.
Read-only report commands call the same connect path as ingest, so a typo or missing database path silently creates an empty database and returns empty reports.
The schema has no versioning, migrations, CHECK constraints, or indexes for report filters, making future changes and larger sacct datasets risky.
Development tooling only declares pytest, so linting and type checks are not reproducible for contributors.
